title: The Nonaligned Hospice
logline: A pacifist medical enclave in a demilitarized buffer system is besieged by both warring factions who demand exclusive control over its trauma facilities.

roles.description: Chief physician of the sanctuary hospital; stubbornly devoted to treating all wounded regardless of uniform or creed.
A ruthless coalition commander enforcing a medical supply embargo against the neutral hospital.
A sprawling orbital hospital complex moored in a demilitarized buffer sector.
An unflagged strike vessel attempting to plunder pharmaceutical stores from the hospital.
A fortified supply terminal in a neighboring system where medicines are tightly rationed.

public_situation: An independent orbital hospice in the demilitarized buffer zone is cut off from medicine and food by competing military blockades.
private_truth: Both warring coalitions fear that if the neutral hospital survives, it will testify before treaty tribunals regarding civilian gas bombardments.

beats.public_change: Emergency distress beacons pulse red across the buffer system as hospital power switches to auxiliary batteries.

missions.reason: The director hires an independent hauler to collect blood plasma containers from an outer triage satellite before cooling systems fail.
missions.private_fact: She is treating high-ranking defectors from both armies in the same ward and cannot reveal their identities to the blockading fleet.

beats.public_change: Both coalitions step up border interdictions, threatening to confiscate medical cargo designated for the buffer zone.

missions.reason: The director funds an unflagged civilian runner to purchase synthetic antibiotics on the open market in a neutral system.
missions.private_fact: She has traded away the hospital's last reserve transport ship to raise the funds for the pharmaceutical purchase.

missions.reason: The commander contracts the pilot to deliver formal requisition warrants demanding the hospital turn over all coalition deserters.
missions.private_fact: His own field hospitals are out of antibiotics and his soldiers are dying from gangrene behind the lines.

beats.public_change: Unmarked raider corvettes begin shelling the hospital's outer hydroponic biodomes to force a surrender.

missions.reason: The director needs a pilot to destroy a privateer corvette that plundered the hospital's oxygen tanks and recover the stolen containers.
missions.private_fact: The raiders were secretly paid by coalition intelligence to loot the hospital without triggering official war crimes charges.

beats.public_change: The blockade closes within point-blank kinetic range of the hospital's central trauma core.

missions.reason: The director needs the pilot to escort the final civilian relief convoy through the blockade cordon.
missions.private_fact: The blockade captain hails mid-fight, offering safe transit if the pilot hands over the hospital's secret chemical warfare logs.

player_choice.prompt: The blockade is broken, but both militaries vow to storm the station unless a political concession is granted.

options.label: Surrender hospital neutrality and accept coalition takeover for protection
Evacuate the patients and staff as refugees across the jump gate

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot breaks the blockade and preserves the hospital's independence.
resolutions.summary: {role:hospice_director} maintains the sanctuary, treating all wounded equally. {role:blockade_commander} faces international reprimand for the siege.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot broke a military blockade, saving an independent orbital hospital and its patients.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot surrenders the chemical logs to the blockade captain during combat.
resolutions.summary: The blockade lifts in exchange for the buried evidence. {role:hospice_director} saves the wards, but the atrocities go unpunished.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot traded casualty files to a blockading commander to buy safe transit for medicine.

resolutions.reached_by: The hospital surrenders its neutrality, becoming a coalition military installation.
resolutions.summary: {role:blockade_commander} takes command of {role:buffer_hospice}. Enemy wounded are expelled as prisoners, and hospital neutrality is permanently extinguished.

consequences.public_summary: A military coalition annexed the buffer hospice, ending its century of impartial mercy.

resolutions.reached_by: The hospital staff evacuates the patients into the refugee diaspora.
resolutions.summary: {role:buffer_hospice} is abandoned as refugees scatter across the gates. {role:hospice_director} goes into exile with the surviving patients.
The blockade strangles the hospital. Power fails, life support collapses, and {role:buffer_hospice} is evacuated in ruins.

loose_threads.detail: The serial numbers on the synthetic antibiotic ampoules match a consignment paid for by a civilian diaspora foundation two jumps away.
A bank audit notice attached to the hospital intake manifest shows that both warring factions hold commercial mortgages on the hospice orbital ring.

radio_hooks: Buffer zone hospice appeals for emergency humanitarian corridors as supply blockades tighten.
Coalition naval command warns civilian freighters away from contested hospital perimeter.
Tribunal envoys demand inspection access to demilitarized buffer station casualties in {system}.

voice_direction.hospice_director: Tired, quiet, but speaks with unshakeable moral firmness. Never raises her voice even under incoming fire.
voice_direction.blockade_commander: Clipped, abrasive, and treats medical treaties as administrative nuisances. Never mentions his own wounded soldiers.
